build_to.study_cross_check_note: SHURIKEN_STUDY.md 2.2's cross-check (50 mm tip, 10 mm arm, 22 mm hub, 35 deg = 3055 mm2, 60.0 g) is 0.51% low: the exact analytic area of that outline is 3070.60 mm2 (60.26 g). See area_check. The measured plate area is lower again because the 0.75 mm ground facets remove material over the taper; the measured mass is the correctness check against the ~60 g target.

hull_method: tip_prism: shuriken_lib.geometry.author_tip_prism_hull, the 8-gon prism through the tips at full plate thickness (exactly C_n, encloses LOD0)

SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD1.method: LOD0 island affine maps (Smart UV planar projection + pack transform, fitted by least squares)

SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD2.method: LOD0 island affine maps (Smart UV planar projection + pack transform, fitted by least squares)

density.hub_topology: rings: hole 24 -> hole 24 at r=12.50 mm -> arm 32 at r=19.01 mm -> rim 48

SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD0.note: study 4 LOD0: full outline, bevels, 24-gon hole ring graded to the hub rim

SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD1.note: study 4 LOD1: hole ring and bevel segments halved; graded hub (8-gon -> 8 ring -> 24 rim)

SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD2.note: study 4 LOD2: bevel and hole dropped

lod_switching.reference_view: 16:9, 90 deg horizontal FOV (Unreal ComputeBoundsScreenSize: S = 1.778 R / d)
lod_switching.why: Study 4's 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.25 put LOD2 - no hole, no bevel - on screen from ~0.36 m, i.e. a star held in first person or lying on a table. The pack sets the thresholds from distance (LOD1 ~0.9 m, LOD2 ~2.5 m for a 5 cm radius) so each switch happens where the LOD's surface deviation is under a pixel or two. They travel in the .sockets.json sidecar (pipeline.export_fbx lod_screen_sizes) and ue_import_sockets applies them.

lod1_is_distinct.note: LODs are authored by the radial-star generator at reduced segment counts (study 4's table), not decimated, so LOD1 is a genuinely different mesh: its hole ring and bevel segments are halved. max_surface_deviation_mm is two-sided (vertices, edge midpoints and triangle centroids of each mesh against the other's surface); the rev2 metric (LOD0 vertices only) is kept for comparison with rev 2's 1e-6 mm.

uv_consistency.method: LOD1..n UV0 from LOD0's island maps (shuriken_lib.uv); one texture set for every LOD

symmetry.method: max nearest-neighbour distance after a 360/8 deg rotation of the stored (float32) vertices. Quarter-turn forms are exact (0.0); any other n is exact in topology and float64 authoring, and lands within float32 storage precision (a few nm) on the stored mesh

physics.source: SHURIKEN_STUDY.md 4, Physics: set an explicit Mass in KG override
physics.applies: Not carried by the FBX or the sidecar, and not applied by the import scripts: set it on the StaticMeshComponent's Body Instance (Physics > Mass (kg) override) in the Blueprint that throws the star, and say so in the Fab description.
physics.note: hull_volume_at_steel_density_kg is the UCX hull volume times 7.85 g/cm3, shown only to say how far a hull-volume mass at steel density would overstate the star. It is NOT Unreal's own figure: without an override Unreal derives mass from the collision volume and the physical material's density (default 1 g/cm3) with RaiseMassToPower 0.75, which was not measured here (StaticMeshComponent.get_mass needs Simulate Physics; UnrealCheck5/mass_diag.json).

engine_check.note: Written 'pending' by the build. The Unreal 5.8 passes run on the exported bytes afterwards (UnrealCheck6: pass 1 import + sidecar, pass 2 fresh-process gates, pass 3 export of the saved asset + Blender round trip), and attach_engine_check.py writes the result here only when the SHA-256 of the FBX and sidecar Unreal imported equal fbx_sha256 / sidecar_sha256 below.
gates: engine LOD triangle counts equal the Blender counts exactly

LightMapCoordinateIndex 1 with a generated UV1 on every LOD

known_gaps: The baked maps are 2048 px per form on a Smart UV layout at ~32 % coverage; the pack atlas (study 4: one 2K atlas, or 1K per star) needs hand-laid shells first. The Unreal side has no M_Shuriken_Master / MI_Shuriken_Blackened asset yet: the validation import runs with import_materials=False, so the slot binds to WorldGridMaterial until the pack's material is built and the three maps are assigned.

The FBX carries only UV0. UV1 (lightmap) exists only because the import generates it (Generate Lightmap UVs ON, src 0 -> dst 1, LightMapCoordinateIndex 1, measured in UnrealCheck5/6): the Fab description and import notes must say so, or a buyer importing with other settings gets no lightmap channel. LightMapResolution is left at Unreal's default 64.

Wear, grind and scratches are procedural in M_Shuriken_Master and reach the engine only through the baked maps; the per-form wear radii, point count and hub radius travel as object custom properties (shuriken_wear_from / _to, shuriken_points, shuriken_hub_r), which the FBX does not export (use_custom_props off) - they matter only to the bake.

LOD0 UV coverage is 32.1% of the square. On the four-point, sweeping the packer over 20 shape x margin combinations moved it only between 26.0% and 32.0%, so the packer is not the limit - Smart UV Project's island shapes are. Hand-laying the shells belongs to the pack-atlas pass.
Physics: the study-4 Mass in KG override (0.06 kg) is recorded here only; it has to be set on the component in the Blueprint (see physics.applies).

Tip angle (35 deg) and arm width (10 mm) are study 2.2 modelling defaults chosen to reproduce the ~60 g mass (study 2: no source publishes a tip angle); reference image A (Happo.JPG) was never downloaded, so the outline has not been checked against a photograph. Built to the study's numbers it reads as much a sprocket as a sun (44 mm hub, parallel-sided spokes); a 'sun' variant would taper the arms from the hub circle or raise the hub to 26-28 mm and re-fit the mass - a study decision.
XXVIM.21, the best-measured eight-point, is only a mass reference: its trident points and rim hole are deliberately not reproduced. The shipped outline is the study's plain-point happo-gata.

LOD2 has no hole by design (study 4), so its two-sided deviation is dominated by the filled 9.5 mm hole; at the pack's 0.035 switch (~2.5 m) the hole is ~3.6 px. Quote the arm-region figure for silhouette loss. LOD2's hub is a fan from the axis (symmetric, aspect ~12 on the notch triangles).
The ground facet is a 0.75 mm convex round-over ending in a 1.0 mm square edge, the four-point's convention, not a flat grind to a thin edge: a pack-wide art call, left as is.

The UCX hull is the 16-vertex tip prism (hull='tip_prism'), not the pipeline's decimated hull (the pipeline hull, probed on this build: 24 verts, 1.118770882 mm off C8, LOD0 up to 0.300021 mm outside it). The prism is a flat 2.5 mm slab through the 8 tips: like any convex hull it spans the gaps between the points, and it stays full thickness over the ground facets, where the steel thins to the 1.0 mm chisel edge at each point (up to 0.75 mm proud per face at the tip). That is the conservative side for a thrown projectile; a stick-into-wall mechanic should trace from a tip (study 4), not rely on this hull.
ENGINE CHECK PENDING: Unreal 5.8 verification of THIS export is not attached yet (engine_check.status). Run WorkFiles/shuriken/UnrealCheck6 passes 1-3 and attach_engine_check.py.

area_check.method: Exact plan area of the un-bevelled outline = hub disc - round hole + 8 x (parallel run outside the hub circle + taper triangle). Parallel run = w * x_taper - cap, cap = integral over |y| <= w/2 of sqrt(r^2 - y^2) = (w/2) sqrt(r^2 - w^2/4) + r^2 asin(w / 2r). Taper triangle = (w/2) * L, L = (w/2) / tan(tip/2). shuriken_lib.spec.analytic_area; mass = area x 2.5 mm x 7.85 g/cm3.

study_slip.explanation: 3055 is 3055.33 mm2 rounded: the area you get when each arm's parallel run is counted as a plain rectangle from the line x = r_hub (10 x (34.142 - 22)) instead of from the hub arc. The arm root actually starts on the arc at x = sqrt(22^2 - 5^2) = 21.424 mm, so 8 circular slivers of 1.9089 mm2 (15.27 mm2 in all) belong to the star and were dropped.
study_slip.same_slip_in_study_2_1: The same formula on the four-point numbers gives 1668.42 mm2 exact (the study's corrected 1668) and 1647.42 mm2 when the arms are counted from the hub radius (the study's original 1647, 1.3% low).

area_check.which_is_right: The exact analytic area, 3070.60 mm2 (60.26 g at 2.5 mm), is the correct area of the outline study 2.2 specifies: an independent shoelace integration of the outline agrees to 1.5e-07 mm2, and the generator's own un-bevelled mesh at LOD0's counts matches the polygonised figure to 7.5e-07 mm2. The study's 3055 mm2 / 60.0 g is 15.60 mm2 (0.51%) low - the same arm-root slip as 2.1's first figure. The measured mesh (3042.09 mm2, 59.70 g) is right for the shipped asset and is lower than the exact outline because the ground bevel removes 27.40 mm2-equivalent and polygonisation 1.11 mm2. That the measured mesh lands near the study's number is a coincidence of two unrelated deficits, not a confirmation of the study's arithmetic.

originality.points: 8 plain single points, 35 deg included - deliberately NOT the three-tipped trident points of Royal Armouries XXVIM.21, which is a mass reference only
originality.hole: round centre hole, 9.5 mm minimum opening (study 2.2: the sourced retail typical) - not XXVIM.21's small hole near the rim beside an engraved dragon's head; no engraving
originality.tip_taper: 35 deg included, ground over the last 15.9 mm, ending in a 1.00 mm chisel edge
originality.finish: blackened oxide, not flat grey: base colour (0.035, 0.034, 0.033) linear with bare steel worn through on the points and the ground bevels - the coating loss on the points is the wear XXVIM.21 records (study 2.2)
originality.stamp: none (study 5; any future mark must be an invented glyph)
originality.franchise_strings: none in any object, mesh, material, texture or file name; qa_check no_franchise_strings passed on 3 of 3 objects

lod_choice.lod0: 2 columns, 2 notch, 3 hole segments per wedge (24-gon hole), hub graded hole 24 -> ring 24 at 12.5 mm -> ring 32 on the arm-corner angles at 19.0 mm -> rim 48; 3 bevel segments, 2 straight, 4 taper, 2 tip intervals
lod_choice.lod1: 1 column, 1 notch, 1 hole segment per wedge (8-gon), hub graded 8 -> ring 8 at 13 mm -> rim 24; 2 bevel segments, 1 straight, 1 taper, 1 tip interval (hand-spelled: study 4 halves the hole ring and bevel segments; the rest is what carries no silhouette at LOD1's size)
lod_choice.lod2: 1 column, 1 notch, no bevel, no hole (study 4); hub fanned symmetrically from the axis
lod_choice.previous_rev1: 16-gon hole bridged 3:1 onto the 48-segment rim: hub aspect median 14.4, max 19.6, 32 of 48 hub faces over 8, every hub face chiral; taper in 2 intervals: 384 triangles under 5 deg (min 3.42 deg); LODs 1504 / 736 / 192

rev3_changes: Not a change list: SM_Shuriken_EightPoint was born on shuriken_lib 3.1 (library rev 3), so it never had the four-point's rev-2 Decimate LODs. Its own history is in maintenance_changes.
maintenance_changes: Revision 2. Hub topology: graded rings (LodSpec.hub_rings) instead of the 3:1 pinwheel fan - LOD0 hub aspect median 3.343, max 4.373, 0 mirror misses (rev 1: 14.4 / 19.6 / every face chiral).
24-gon hole on LOD0 (was 16: corners visible in the hero), measured 9.5 mm across the flats; LOD0 taper in 4 intervals, min triangle angle 6.696 deg, 0 under 5 deg (rev 1: 3.42 deg, 384).
LODs [2336, 608, 192] (rev 1: 1504 / 736 / 192), all in the study 4 bands. LOD1 differs from LOD0 by 0.350376 mm two-sided: 0.350376 mm in the hub (8-gon), 0.26289 mm on the arms.
LOD1/LOD2 UV0 now come from LOD0's islands (shuriken_lib.uv): one texture set serves every LOD (cross_lod_uv, uv_consistency).
Textures: T_Shuriken_EightPoint_BC / _ORM / _N baked from M_Shuriken_Master (textures); the gallery beauty shots render from those maps only (render_gates.beauty_source).
LOD screen sizes [1.0, 0.1, 0.035] (study 4's 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.25 switched to LOD2 at 0.36 m); see lod_switching.
measured.tip_included_deg is now fitted to the taper edges of all 8 arms (was copied from the spec); the bevel is reported in arm-local stations (bevel_start_arm_x_mm, bevel_full_size_arm_x_mm).
engine_check is bound to the SHA-256 of the exported FBX and sidecar (UnrealCheck6).
fixes_applied: Inherited by construction, not re-fixed: every rev-2 four-point lesson is in the library - the plate and ground bevel are authored (no bmesh.ops.bevel clamping), every vertex goes through the 1 nm orbit-keyed factory and the hygiene gate refuses zero-length edges, zero-area faces and coincident vertices before an object exists (measured here: 0 / 0 / 0).
Centre hole: circumscribed 24-gon, 9.500 mm across the flats (the true minimum opening), as the four-point.
Bevel: 0.75 mm requested, 0.75 mm measured on the finished mesh.
LOD screen sizes [1.0, 0.1, 0.035] travel in the .sockets.json sidecar (pipeline.export_fbx lod_screen_sizes) and are applied by ue_import_sockets after import.
Sockets are Empties through the sidecar (FBX sockets land at scale 100); the hull keys to the LOD0 node name (UCX_SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD0_00).
